evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes equal digest/different time and identical untracked art with unchanged inode/mtime/bytes. Timestamp mirroring is intentionally retired. Equal content avoids redundant publication.

scenario: Series-artwork commit fails after book-sidecar commit
requirement: Recoverable partial state, original series art preserved, accurate event/counts.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate includes real pipeline SIGKILL after book/sidecar publication and series-art ENOSPC/EACCES cases. Fresh recover retains old/staged/backup artwork, tracks partial members, emits no premature group event, and does not republish verified books. The earlier 39-case gate also passed.

scenario: Book upgrade/remove affects associated artwork
requirement: Only known owned/relevant sidecars updated; unrelated poster/image not guessed and deleted.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes strict upgrade/retirement, custom poster, unrelated generation, and same-stem owner cases. Original prechange releases remain ownership evidence while retired books leave the active catalog. Only relevant/journal-proven artwork moves or quarantines.

scenario: Existing book plus better incoming copy; staging fails
requirement: Existing good book and incoming copy remain intact (R01).
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes strict/collection upgrade pre-stage failures and group-retained-byte budget cases. Existing good books, component books, and incoming copies retain their exact bytes when staging fails; no commit event precedes publication.

scenario: Same destination name, different bytes in rename and every merge path
requirement: Preserve both; return conflict/review-required, never auto-delete (R03/R04).
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes real filename/group/directory merge collisions. transaction-gap-first-five.json adds occupied restructure/upgrade book and artwork destinations with unchanged candidate manifests and zero overwrite. The later outer fixture failure is not treated as a scenario pass.

scenario: Target created by another cooperating writer during apply
requirement: No-clobber invariant holds; no exists-then-write race accepted.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes real target-created-after-stage and immediately-before-publish races plus two-process root-lock refusal. No-clobber hard-link publication preserves the external writer target and incoming candidate. No exists-then-write fallback is used.

scenario: Source/target fingerprint changes between planning and apply
requirement: Stale plan refused with clear reason.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes stale source/replacement target and planning near-publication fingerprint cases. Current bytes survive with explicit stale_plan/conflict and no unauthorized destination or prevalidation state creation.

scenario: Modified plan file points outside permitted roots
requirement: Revalidate plan inputs and permissions; serialized plan is not trusted authorization.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes modified-plan root/destination authorization cases. Executor permissions and invocation RunAuthorization are revalidated independently of serialized plan content. CLI does not accept arbitrary executable plans or function/command names.

scenario: /books versus /books-old, different drives, overlapping roots
requirement: Component-based policy/mapping works; no substring authorization (R12).
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes /books versus /books-old, conflicting nested roots/mappings, duplicate physical-root roles, and logical remote-drive prefixes. Containment uses path components and longest matching mapping. Actual Windows drive/filesystem behavior remains outside the Linux proof.

scenario: Symlink/reparse point in source, destination, or parent
requirement: Explicit safe rejection/default and residual race model; no escape of target roots.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes source, target, and parent symlinks plus unsafe artwork/native preparation links on Linux. Revalidation refuses traversal before publication. Cooperating local locks do not eliminate residual external-writer TOCTOU; Windows junction/reparse execution is unrun.

scenario: EXDEV move from another filesystem
requirement: Stage/copy/validate/publish; source removed only in authorized post-commit cleanup.
evidence: VERIFICATION records a real /tmp-to-/dev/shm move with different device IDs, verified destination bytes, retained original, and authorized post-commit cleanup. Recorded 1502 gate separately passes simulated EXDEV staged-copy behavior. Real-mount and simulated evidence are not conflated.

scenario: Filesystem does not support selected no-clobber primitive
requirement: Tested safe alternative or fail closed; never silent overwrite fallback.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate faults unsupported hard links and proves fail-closed publication with retained source and unclobbered target. No weaker check-then-rename substitute is used. This is tested Linux local behavior, not a claim for every filesystem.

scenario: Case-only rename, two-file swap, cyclic directory plan
requirement: Safe intermediates and recovery; no in-place destructive loop.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes Linux case-only rename, book/sidecar swaps, and cycle recovery. transaction-gap-first-five.json adds an actual three-occupied-path rotation killed after first publication and recovered fresh with all identities retained. Actual case-insensitive Windows/NTFS or equivalent filesystem proof is unavailable.

scenario: Disk full/permission loss during stage, backup, publish and cleanup
requirement: Correct state classification at each stage, prior content recoverable.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes ENOSPC/EACCES immediately before/after stage, backup, publish, and cleanup plus real series-art publication faults. Fresh recover inspects member phases and retained old/new bytes, never inflating committed counts or claiming durable success on failed flush.

scenario: Crash before and after intent record and staging
requirement: Restart identifies owned scratch/intent; no unrelated file cleanup.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes real process kills on both sides of operation intent, before stage intent/stage, after stage, and before publish. Fresh recovery identifies recorded owned scratch without removing unrelated lookalikes or inventing an unrecorded operation.

scenario: Crash after prior destination preserved but before publication
requirement: Recovery restores/preserves usable original or safely finishes known operation.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes backed-up replacement process death and rollback-retention cases. Fresh recovery verifies independent retained original/new bytes before finishing or restoring. Target existence alone is not recovery proof.

scenario: Crash after publication but before committed journal record
requirement: Reconcile content and intent; no second destructive replacement.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes publication-before-journal-commit process kills and changed-target review. Fresh/repeated recovery reconciles recorded fingerprints, preserves prior/new candidates, and does not destructively replace a verified published member twice.

scenario: Crash after commit before source cleanup/notification
requirement: Resume cleanup/delivery independently; file mutation not repeated.
evidence: transaction-gap-connected-delivery.json PASS kills after local commit before cleanup/delivery, then recovers fresh with zero newly committed count. A kill after one real durable mutation and fresh/repeat dispatch produces no duplicate file event/POST. Recorded 1502 gate preserves independently pending outbox work even when recover commits zero.

scenario: Group of book, multiple sidecars and series cover partly committed
requirement: Journal tracks individual steps; conservative recover/compensate behavior.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate includes a real composed book/two-sidecar/owned-series-art group at publication, commit, and cleanup SIGKILL boundaries. Journal tracks each member; prior artwork and candidate bytes survive. Fresh recover finishes conservatively without republishing verified members or emitting false group success.

scenario: Journal unavailable/corrupt, unsupported schema, failed migration
requirement: Fail safely; no writes whose recovery cannot be recorded.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes corrupt/unavailable state, unknown schema version, trigger/view/index, unwritable journal, and store-identity mismatch before publication. Only schema version 1 is accepted. No unjournaled filesystem mutation follows failed initialization/migration.

scenario: Two application processes act on same root/series
requirement: Locking or explicit single-writer refusal verified; conflicts not silently resolved.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes real competing apply/recovery processes under deterministic physical-root and state ownership locks. A second writer cannot publish or poison a live journal. Abandoned locks require validated recovery ownership, not a stale-PID guess. No distributed NAS lock guarantee.

scenario: Preview of organize/duplicate/convert/recover
requirement: No library mutation; intended consequences visible before apply.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual organize/duplicates/convert/recover previews, including existing journal and unknown remote work. Installed/container manifest receipts show intended plans with unchanged library/state/log bytes and zero remote mutations. Explicit named output remains the only publication exception.

scenario: Identical duplicates with cleanup disabled/enabled
requirement: Disabled preserves both; enabled performs only explicitly scoped audited cleanup.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes identical duplicate preview/disabled preservation and explicitly authorized redundant-input quarantine. A verified keeper remains intact. Automatic candidate selection under manual_delete=false is policy, never implicit apply authority.

scenario: Hidden files and almost-empty folder
requirement: Do not delete unrelated hidden files or parent/root directories as “cleanup.”
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes hidden files, nested assets, lone/custom artwork, chapter exceptions, and configured-root retention. rmdir removes only an actually empty authorized nonroot directory. Legacy hidden-file and sole-cover purges are intentionally retired.

scenario: Failure of fsync or unsupported directory flush
requirement: Document actual durability level; no successful durable-commit claim without required guarantees.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes file/directory fsync faults before and after publication and refusal to reuse unflushed stage/backup. Prepublish fails closed; postpublish retains candidates/journal for recovery without durable-success. Actual durability evidence is Linux local filesystem only; NAS/NTFS is not inferred.

scenario: Representative supported RAR/CBR/7z archive
requirement: Valid CBZ with intended member paths/data and metadata.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes genuine ISC-licensed compressed/solid RAR and generated 7z conversion, canonical member-path/hash manifests, nested Unicode paths, and original retention. Installed conversion decodes through unrar 1:7.2.4-1 and locked py7zr 1.1.3. Native import success is not the proof.

scenario: Native tool or optional Python package absent
requirement: Actionable capability error; no source deletion or fake success.
evidence: Current 1506 gate passes missing unrar and no-fallback boundaries without source deletion. Refreshed conversion/core/other-extra wheel receipts PASS actual selected conversion and targeted absent-package errors. Native unrar 1:7.2.4-1 and generated 7z work are independently exercised; import presence alone is not conversion proof.

scenario: Existing same-stem CBZ with same/different content
requirement: Explicit conflict/duplicate policy via shared executor.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes invalid/different same-stem CBZ collisions and validated identical outputs. Existing files are never predeleted. Identical content skips without source retirement; replacement needs explicit concrete authority and retained prior bytes.

scenario: Extraction timeout, process nonzero exit, corrupt member
requirement: Preserve source; controlled owned-scratch cleanup; diagnostic captures bounded output.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes decoder deadline/nonzero/over-output/corrupt input, real solid-RAR cancellation, and owned process-group reaping. Original and journal-bound scratch survive as required. Recorded native decoder/descendant PIDs distinguish genuine native execution from substitute worker lifecycle proof.

scenario: Filename contains spaces, shell metacharacters or leading dash
requirement: Argument-array invocation and option handling; no shell interpretation.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate decodes a genuine compressed solid RAR named with a leading dash, spaces, semicolon, and $(not-executed). Native commands use argument arrays; decoded manifest is verified and no shell effect occurs.

scenario: Archive links/traversal or excessive expansion
requirement: Refuse safely under budgets; no writes outside scratch.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual 7z/RAR link/traversal/duplicate/expansion refusal and WriterFactory streamed per-member/cumulative caps. Out-of-scratch sentinels and source bytes survive. Entry metadata and supervised worker limits supplement declared-header budgets.

scenario: Multivolume/encrypted/solid archive edge cases
requirement: Supported behavior tested or unsupported reason explicit; no silent partial conversion.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes complete unencrypted multipart RAR, incomplete/changed-part failure, solid decode, and explicit encrypted-input unsupported results. Every source part remains until verified grouped publication and separately authorized cleanup. No password guessing or partial-success conversion.

scenario: Conversion completed but validation/publication/cleanup fails
requirement: Distinct states; original preserved until validated commit and authorized cleanup.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes validated native stage followed by publication/cleanup failure, multipart race, and fresh recovery. Source parts and recorded stage remain recoverable. First new group commit counts one; cleanup-only/completed recovery counts zero and never republishes.

scenario: Required metadata/ZIP comment/artwork assets survive conversion
requirement: Compare semantic/member contents; no accidental drop in packaging path.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate compares actual 7z nested images/XML/OPF/extensionless assets and real RAR archive/member comments against published CBZ manifests. Paths and content hashes survive, not merely archive names or import success.

scenario: Extension correction without format conversion
requirement: Rename reflects verified container interpretation; no false conversion claim.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes header-only ZIP comic/EPUB correction separately from native conversion. Recorded supervised correction retains exact book and same-stem art bytes. Full-run composition observes corrected virtual names without a false format-conversion count.

scenario: File grows, pauses with same size, then resumes
requirement: Not treated as permanently complete after one unchanged-size sample (R09).
evidence: watch-lifecycle-proof.json PASS uses real Linux inotify and the canonical pipeline with a paused/resumed writer and archive readiness rechecks before actual WebP commit. Recorded 1502 gate covers growth and downloader observations. Stability alone remains evidence, not a guarantee against any external paused writer.

scenario: Modify-in-place with unchanged directory mtime
requirement: Reconciliation/file fingerprint detects relevant change (R13).
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes same-size edit with restored file/unchanged directory mtime and new quiet-window recovery cases. WatchCoordinator compares source fingerprints, not directory timestamps, and treats changed bytes at one path as a new generation.

scenario: Rename/move completed book into watched directory
requirement: Candidate discovered even without original created event.
evidence: watch-lifecycle-proof.json PASS renames completed temporary archives into real inotify roots, then commits two Atlas and one Boreal generations. Recorded 1502 gate covers moved/create/modify/delete intake and reconciliation without requiring an earlier created event.

scenario: Repeated/burst/coalesced events for same source
requirement: One effective job per valid observation; no duplicate destructive commit.
evidence: watch-lifecycle-proof.json PASS injects 2000 duplicate events through the real coordinator and observes one canonical commit per source fingerprint plus zero-commit repeats. Recorded 1502 gate covers coalesced intake and durable generation identities.

scenario: Queue at capacity and notification overflow
requirement: Bounded memory; backpressure or reconciliation preserves correctness.
evidence: watch-lifecycle-proof.json PASS exercises real canonical-pipeline overflow. watch-long-run-after.json negative/failed-hook scenarios separately bound active state at limit 16 with preserved reconciliation and untouched pending inputs. Recorded 1502 gate adds apply admission-cursor fairness. Completed durable audit history is not claimed bounded; W12 remains partial.

scenario: Application writes sidecars/temp files/quarantine
requirement: No recursive self-triggering processing loop.
evidence: watch-lifecycle-proof.json PASS decodes actual generated WebP and observes no feedback-loop commits. Recorded 1502 gate excludes sidecars, state, staging, quarantine, hidden names, and custom-filter attempts from source intake.

scenario: File disappears or mount disconnects during readiness
requirement: Explicit deferred/missing state with bounded retry; no global crash.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes deleted-observation cancellation, missing-root defer/recreation, and real local PollingObserver rebuild after directory replacement. Retries are bounded and explicit. Directory replacement simulates remount behavior; it does not prove an actual NAS/removable mount.

scenario: Two files for same series plus independent other series
requirement: Serialize conflicting changes; unrelated work can proceed within bounds.
evidence: watch-lifecycle-proof.json PASS processes two Atlas books plus independent Boreal through one real active pipeline, with eventual unique commits and retained bytes. Recorded 1502 gate preserves selected roots and serial execution. Parallel per-series throughput is not promised.

scenario: Shutdown during readiness, processing or remote retry
requirement: Intake stops, pending state preserved, workers/resources terminate cleanly.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate covers SIGTERM readiness checkpoint and observer cleanup. watch-long-run-after.json cancel-archive and cancel-post scenarios PASS actual owned worker reaping. Precommit cancellation retains resumable work; post-send cancellation keeps the local commit and durable unknown review. Its unrelated lifecycle fixture failure is not a whole-run pass.

scenario: Restart with completed, pending, stale and failed jobs
requirement: Correct invalidation/replay; no reuse solely by path.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes fresh-process complete/pending/interrupted/changed-generation watch recovery. Recorded before/after receipts retain prior SHA delivery-review obligation while admitting the replacement fingerprint, which correctly conflicts rather than replaying old work. Path-only reuse is not allowed.

scenario: Monotonic and wall clocks diverge
requirement: Quiet windows/retry intervals unaffected by wall-clock jumps.
evidence: watch-long-run-after.json monotonic scenario PASS observes two transient invalid archives with unchanged 4-second retry eligibility despite +31622400/-63244800-second wall jumps. Recorded 1502 gate separately covers quiet-window divergence. Outer lifecycle fixture failure does not invalidate this recorded scenario result.

scenario: Long run with many paths, negative matches and failed hooks
requirement: Cache, outbox and pending-job retention bounded and observable.
evidence: watch-long-run-after.json has PASS negative/failed-hook/completed-history scenarios over 64 paths and 512 ticks at active limit 16. Negative inputs all become observable with zero mutations; failed hooks retain 16 review/failed rows and leave 48 sources untouched, with measured stable RSS. Completed journal/outbox audit history is explicitly uncapped. No bounded durable-history, asymptotic, NAS, or performance claim.

scenario: Polling fallback on declared deployment filesystem
requirement: Actual support tested or limitation explicit; fake event tests not labeled NAS verification.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual local Linux PollingObserver/root-replacement behavior. Actual SMB/NFS/FUSE/NAS or other declared shared-filesystem fixtures are unavailable. This blocked platform portion is explicit; fake events or local directory replacement are not NAS verification.

scenario: Base URL contains path prefix and configured port/auth
requirement: Correct request URL/auth; no dropped prefix or duplicated port.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual loopback prefixed URLs, UTF-8 Basic auth, embedded/explicit/empty separate ports, and proxy/netrc isolation. Recorded Komga GET and confirmed 202 scan preserve prefix and optional-port behavior. Live deployment compatibility is not claimed.

scenario: Library list success, malformed payload, auth denied and server error
requirement: Distinct typed outcomes; service failure not treated as empty library.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual loopback valid/empty library payloads, malformed schemas, 401/403, and exhausted 503 retries. get_komga_libraries distinguishes service failure from an empty valid list with typed outcomes, not fallback equality.

scenario: Connection/read/write/pool stall
requirement: Explicit bounds and cleanup; no indefinite pipeline hang (R10).
evidence: transport-final-proof.json PASS proves actual stalled TLS establishment and blocked upload at the unmodified 60-second deadline plus cancellation, with every owned worker reaped. Recorded 1502 gate also covers read/header/body stalls. Per-attempt Requests sessions use max_retries=0 and pool_block=false; no shared blocking pool exists to exhaust.

scenario: Several committed changes in same library
requirement: Scan coalesced according to documented policy, after successful commits.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes transaction-backed postcommit Komga intent/coalescing and authorization cases, not only pure mapping. delivery creates unique operation/library scan rows after verified commits and coalesces affected libraries. Loopback request observations remain distinct from live Komga proof.

scenario: Failed file operation
requirement: No scan/success event falsely associated with an uncommitted change.
evidence: transaction-gap-komga-failure.json PASS observes scan-enabled publication failure with zero wire requests and zero success events. Fresh positive recovery produces exactly one confirmed scan. Recorded 1502 gate passes local-event/source-failure delivery boundaries.

scenario: Timeout after scan POST may have reached server
requirement: No blind exactly-once claim or unsafe unbounded replay; method-aware strategy.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual scan POST timeout and durable unknown acceptance/restart cases. One possible mutation remains pending_unknown/review rather than blindly rescanned. Connected delivery recovery retains local identity and does not imply exactly-once remote delivery.

scenario: Local and server roots differ, overlapping prefixes
requirement: Explicit mapping and longest valid component prefix; no drive-stripping guess.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes longest valid local-to-remote component-prefix mappings and excludes /books-old from /books. Explicit PathMapping replaces drive stripping. Logical mapping and real loopback request contracts are proved; actual server mount compatibility remains unrun.

scenario: Redirect or unexpected host in authenticated request
requirement: Explicit security policy; no credential forwarding to arbitrary target.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual TLS certificate refusal, authenticated cross-origin/outside-prefix redirect denial, and mutation redirect refusal. Wire capture shows no forwarded credentials to arbitrary hosts. No live endpoint or bypass is used.

scenario: Same call arguments repeated across several Discord hooks
requirement: Rotation advances without memoization (R08).
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual loopback identical-message hook rotation and failure advancement. pipeline-isolation-proof.json confirms independent route assignments for two complete pipelines. Selection is run-owned and never memoized; arrival order is not the rotation proof.

scenario: Multiple notifications with different embeds/attachments
requirement: No stale mutable payload bleed; correct attachment bytes/type/name.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual fresh JSON/multipart PNG/WebP attachment names, media types, bytes, and no payload bleed. transport-final-proof.json producer cases preserve real raster bytes/pixels/hash multiset through durable batches.

scenario: Fields/batches/attachments near current service limits
requirement: Split/truncate according to verified documented limits; preserve meaningful message content.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes field/aggregate text/ten-embed boundaries. transport-final-proof.json cites official Discord message/webhook limits and PASS real multipart attachment, 20MiB aggregate minus/at/plus boundaries, encoded request below 25MiB, and 67108864-byte worker JSON admission. Meaningful names/numbers and raster content are preserved or explicitly rejected; live upload entitlement is not assumed.

scenario: 429, permanent failure, transient failure and ambiguous delivery
requirement: Bounded documented retries; honor permitted delay; no file-operation replay.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes 429 Retry-After bounds, permanent/read-only retry, and durable ambiguous mutation cases. http-predispatch-after.json proves quota/cancel/launch failures are typed definite-unsent with zero wire. Successful worker spawn stays conservative unknown. Connected delivery recovery and transport-final-proof.json show no local replay or blind unknown POST replay.

scenario: Main/BookWalker/new-volume channels configured separately

evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes actual loopback normal/new-release/BookWalker released/preorder routing and independent normal rotation. Current secrets resolve at dispatch from channel IDs, not persisted webhook URLs. Synthetic BookWalker content is not current live-site compatibility.

scenario: Hook failure and error logging

A permitted versioned real current-DOM fixture remains unavailable; synthetic parser coverage is not live DOM parity.

evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes BookWalker consumer distinctions for 403, 429, empty/non-HTML responses, and changed synthetic DOM. Actual loopback transport enforces denial/retry/deadline policy. No access-control bypass, fabricated empty success, or live BookWalker compatibility claim.

scenario: Released today, future preorder, no date, parts and collections
requirement: Injected explicit date semantics; unknown date not invented as released.
evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes injected-clock today/released/preorder/unknown/invalid date cases plus exact parts/collections. Known date ordering remains explicit; absent price is unknown and missing date never becomes fabricated release/preorder data. HTML fixtures are synthetic.

evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes shortened-search early-return/raise and below-threshold alternative similarity cases. The 0.03 single-series relaxation remains local. Later unrelated searches retain the configured global snapshot threshold.

evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes grouping duplicate URLs and all literal book identities in numeric order. group_bookwalker_books does not mutate its traversed list or drop repeated-series releases. Source fixtures remain synthetic.

scenario: Local library comparison with remote ranges/parts/unknowns

evidence: Recorded 1502 gate passes exact membership/range coverage/set holes/part/premium and unknown remote comparison. compare_bookwalker_releases preserves uncertainty rather than inventing no releases or false coverage. No live remote catalog is claimed.
